# **sdvplotR**

[**`sdvplotR`**](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/) plots sports
team logos, wordmarks, player headshots and team colors across the **28
leagues** of the SportsDataverse team index
([`sdv_leagues()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_leagues.md))
— NFL, NBA, WNBA, MLB, NHL, college football, men’s and women’s college
basketball, soccer and more — in
[**`ggplot2`**](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/) plots,
[**`gt`**](https://gt.rstudio.com/) tables and
[**`reactable`**](https://glin.github.io/reactable/) tables, and in
interactive [**`plotly`**](https://plotly-r.com/),
[**`ggiraph`**](https://davidgohel.github.io/ggiraph/) and
[**`leaflet`**](https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/) charts and maps,
with team-colored playing surfaces from
[**`sportyR`**](https://sportyR.sportsdataverse.org/). It is built on
[**`ggpath`**](https://mrcaseb.github.io/ggpath/) and unifies the
approach established by [nflplotR](https://nflplotr.nflverse.com/),
[cfbplotR](https://cfbplotR.sportsdataverse.org/),
[nbaplotR](https://mrcaseb.github.io/nbaplotR/) and
[mlbplotR](https://camdenk.github.io/mlbplotR/) behind one `league`
argument.

![Every NFL team's 2023 regular season drawn as its logo, placed by
points scored and allowed per game.](reference/figures/README-home.png)

Part of the [SportsDataverse](https://sportsdataverse.org/) family of R
packages for sports analytics.

Data freshness and pipeline status for every SportsDataverse dataset:
[sportsdataverse.org/status](https://sportsdataverse.org/status).

## **Installation**

Once on CRAN, install the released version with:

``` r

install.packages("sdvplotR")
```

Install the development version of
[**`sdvplotR`**](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sdvplotR) from
GitHub with:

``` r

# using the pak package (recommended):
if (!requireNamespace("pak", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pak")
}
pak::pak("sportsdataverse/sdvplotR")
```

``` r

# or from R-universe (binary builds):
install.packages("sdvplotR", repos = c("https://sportsdataverse.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

### **Python**

The same team colors, logos, wordmarks and headshots are on PyPI as
[**`sdvplot`**](https://pypi.org/project/sdvplot/) (Python 3.10+), with
adapters for matplotlib and seaborn, plotnine, Plotly, Altair, Bokeh,
HoloViews, great_tables and folium. `sdvplot.great_tables` ports this
package’s table themes, cell styling, legends and image export. Docs:
[sdvplot.sportsdataverse.org](https://sdvplot.sportsdataverse.org/).
Source:
[sportsdataverse/sdvplot](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sdvplot).

``` sh
pip install sdvplot
```

### **JavaScript / TypeScript**

They are also on npm as
[**`@sportsdataverse/sdvplot`**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sportsdataverse/sdvplot),
with Observable Plot, D3, React and chart-library integrations plus shot
charts.
[**`@sportsdataverse/sdvtables`**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sportsdataverse/sdvtables)
is the counterpart to the `gt` table helpers. Docs:
[plot.sportsdataverse.org](https://plot.sportsdataverse.org). Source:
[sportsdataverse/sdvplot-js](https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sdvplot-js).

``` sh
npm install @sportsdataverse/sdvplot @sportsdataverse/sdvtables @sportsdataverse/sporty
```

## **Usage**

Every function takes a `league` argument (`"nfl"`, `"nba"`, `"wnba"`,
`"mlb"`, `"nhl"`, `"cfb"`, `"mbb"`, `"wbb"`, `"soccer"` and the rest of
[`sdv_leagues()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_leagues.md)).
Team identifiers are resolved automatically: full names, abbreviations
from other data providers (ESPN, nflverse, MLB Stats, nba_api, NHL,
CFBD, NCAA and more) and the codes of relocated franchises all resolve
to the same team.
[`sdv_resolve()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_resolve.md)
shows the id a value resolves to,
[`sdv_suggest()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_suggest.md)
proposes candidates for a typo, and `season` selects the era for codes
that were reused.

``` r

library(sdvplotR)
library(ggplot2)

# NFL team logos in a grid
df <- data.frame(
  a     = rep(1:8, 4),
  b     = sort(rep(1:4, 8), decreasing = TRUE),
  teams = sdv_teams("nfl")$abbr
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = a, y = b)) +
  geom_sdv_logos(aes(team = teams), league = "nfl", width = 0.075) +
  theme_void()
```

``` r

# Logos as axis labels + team colours as fill
df2 <- data.frame(
  team  = c("KC", "BUF", "SF", "DAL"),
  score = c(42, 38, 35, 30)
)

ggplot(df2, aes(x = team, y = score)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = team), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_sdv(league = "nfl") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_sdv_logo(league = "nfl", size = 1))
```

``` r

library(gt)

# Logos inside a gt table, in the SportsDataverse table theme
data.frame(team = c("KC", "BUF", "SF"), wins = c(13, 12, 11)) |>
  gt() |>
  gt_sdv_logos(columns = "team", league = "nfl") |>
  gt_theme_sdv()

# ...or dressed in one team's colors
data.frame(player = c("Patrick Mahomes", "Travis Kelce"), yards = c(4183, 984)) |>
  gt() |>
  gt_theme_sdv_team(team = "KC", league = "nfl")
```

``` r

library(reactable)

# Logos inside a reactable table with team-coloured bars
df3 <- data.frame(team = c("KC", "BUF", "SF"), wins = c(13, 12, 11))

reactable(
  df3,
  columns = list(
    team = colDef(cell = reactable_sdv_logos(league = "nfl"), html = TRUE),
    wins = colDef(style = reactable_sdv_team_color_bar(df3, "team", league = "nfl"))
  )
)
```

``` r

# Interactive: the logo grid again, each logo with a tooltip (ggiraph) ...
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = a, y = b)) +
  geom_sdv_logos_interactive(aes(team = teams, tooltip = teams, data_id = teams),
    league = "nfl", width = 0.075
  ) +
  theme_void()
ggiraph::girafe(ggobj = p)

# ... or logos on a native plotly chart (addSdvLogoMarkers() does maps)
plotly::plot_ly(df, x = ~a, y = ~b, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", text = ~teams) |>
  add_sdv_logos(df$a, df$b, df$teams, league = "nfl")

# A playing surface painted in a team's colors, ready for shot or play data
sdv_surface("nba", team = "BOS")
```

The [Interactive Charts
cookbook](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/cookbook-interactive.html)
covers
[`geom_sdv_logos_interactive()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/geom_sdv_logos_interactive.md)
and its wordmark and headshot siblings,
[`add_sdv_logos()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/add_sdv_logos.md),
[`sdv_axis_logos()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_axis_logos.md)
and
[`sdv_colorway()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_colorway.md)
for plotly, and
[`addSdvLogoMarkers()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/addSdvLogoMarkers.md)
for leaflet.

[`gt_theme_sdv()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_sdv.md)
(light or `style = "dark"`) and
[`gt_theme_sdv_team()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_sdv_team.md)
are the SportsDataverse table themes. The `gt` side also carries the
[gtUtils](https://github.com/andreweatherman/gtUtils) toolkit by Andrew
Weatherman: 18 table themes
([`gt_theme_kenpom()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_kenpom.md),
[`gt_theme_savant()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_savant.md),
[`gt_theme_athletic()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_athletic.md),
…), color legends, cut lines, significance notation, outlier flags,
faceted grids and
[`gt_save_crop()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_save_crop.md)
/
[`gt_social_crop()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_social_crop.md)
for publishing.

Dark-mode logo variants are available through `variant = "dark"` in the
table helpers, and
[`sdv_teams()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_teams.md)
exposes the full reference data (ESPN ids, colors, conference) for every
team.

## **Cheat sheet**

A printable four-page reference for **sdvplotR**: team logos, colors and
scales in ggplot2, team identity, the plotly, ggiraph and leaflet
integrations, surfaces, and the gt and reactable toolkits, in four color
themes, light and dark.

📄 [**Download the sdvplotR cheat sheet
(PDF)**](https://sportsdataverse.org/cheatsheets/sdvplotR.pdf)

Browse the other SportsDataverse cheat sheets at
[**sportsdataverse.org/cheatsheets**](https://sportsdataverse.org/cheatsheets).

## **The SportsDataverse**

`sdvplotR` draws the pictures; the companion packages fetch the data.

| Package | Sport / Scope |
|----|----|
| [**cfbfastR**](https://cfbfastR.sportsdataverse.org/) | College football |
| [**hoopR**](https://hoopR.sportsdataverse.org/) | Men’s basketball (NBA and NCAA) |
| [**wehoop**](https://wehoop.sportsdataverse.org/) | Women’s basketball (WNBA and NCAA) |
| [**fastRhockey**](https://fastRhockey.sportsdataverse.org/) | Hockey (NHL and PWHL) |
| [**baseballr**](https://billpetti.github.io/baseballr/) | Baseball (MLB, MiLB, NCAA) |
| [**nflfastR**](https://github.com/nflverse/nflfastR) · [**nflreadr**](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/) | NFL play-by-play and data loaders |
| [**oddsapiR**](https://oddsapiR.sportsdataverse.org/) | Sports betting odds |
| [**cfbseedR**](https://cfbseedR.sportsdataverse.org/) | CFB seeding and playoff simulation |
| [**sportyR**](https://sportyR.sportsdataverse.org/) | Playing-surface plots |
| [**sportsdataverse-R**](https://r.sportsdataverse.org/) | Umbrella R metapackage |
| [**sdvplot**](https://sdvplot.sportsdataverse.org/) | Python plots and tables |
| [**@sportsdataverse/sdvplot**](https://plot.sportsdataverse.org) · [**@sportsdataverse/sdvtables**](https://plot.sportsdataverse.org/guides/tables) | JavaScript / TypeScript plots and tables |
| [**sportsdataverse-py**](https://py.sportsdataverse.org/) · [**sportsdataverse.js**](https://js.sportsdataverse.org/) | Python and Node.js |

See the full ecosystem at
[sportsdataverse.org](https://sportsdataverse.org/).

# Package index

## Logos, Wordmarks & Headshots

ggplot2 geoms and ggproto objects for rendering team logos, wordmarks
and player headshots on plots. Every geom takes a `league` argument.

- [`geom_sdv_logos()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/geom_sdv_logos.md)
  [`GeomSDVlogo`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/geom_sdv_logos.md)
  : ggplot2 Layer for Visualizing Sports Team Logos
- [`geom_sdv_wordmarks()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/geom_sdv_wordmarks.md)
  [`GeomSDVwordmark`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/geom_sdv_wordmarks.md)
  : ggplot2 Layer for Visualizing Sports Team Wordmarks
- [`geom_sdv_headshots()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/geom_sdv_headshots.md)
  [`GeomSDVheadshot`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/geom_sdv_headshots.md)
  : ggplot2 Layer for Visualizing Player Headshots

## Theme Elements

Image-based ggplot2 theme elements for axis text — replace tick labels
with team logos, wordmarks or player headshots.

- [`element_sdv_logo()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/element_sdv.md)
  [`element_sdv_wordmark()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/element_sdv.md)
  [`element_sdv_headshot()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/element_sdv.md)
  [`element_sdv_raster()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/element_sdv.md)
  : Theme Elements for Image Grobs

## Scales & Axes

Team color / fill scales, logo and headshot axis scales, and the
matching theme helpers.

- [`scale_color_sdv()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/scale_sdv.md)
  [`scale_colour_sdv()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/scale_sdv.md)
  [`scale_fill_sdv()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/scale_sdv.md)
  : Scales for Sports Team Colors
- [`scale_x_sdv()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/scale_axes_sdv.md)
  [`scale_y_sdv()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/scale_axes_sdv.md)
  [`scale_x_sdv_headshots()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/scale_axes_sdv.md)
  [`scale_y_sdv_headshots()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/scale_axes_sdv.md)
  : Axis Scales for Sports Team Logos
- [`theme_x_sdv()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/theme_sdv.md)
  [`theme_y_sdv()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/theme_sdv.md)
  : Theme Helpers for SDV Axis Labels

## gt Table Helpers

Embed team logos, wordmarks and player headshots inside gt table cells
or column labels, and stack team-colored text.

- [`gt_sdv_logos()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_sdv_logos.md)
  : Render Logos in 'gt' Tables
- [`gt_sdv_wordmarks()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_sdv_wordmarks.md)
  : Render Wordmarks in 'gt' Tables
- [`gt_sdv_headshots()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_sdv_headshots.md)
  : Render Player Headshots in 'gt' Tables
- [`gt_sdv_cols_label()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_sdv_cols_label.md)
  : Render Logos in 'gt' Table Column Labels
- [`gt_merge_stack_team_color()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_merge_stack_team_color.md)
  : Merge and Stack Text in gt Tables with Team Colors

## SportsDataverse Table Themes

The SportsDataverse house table, in light and dark, and a version
dressed in any team’s colors.

- [`gt_theme_sdv()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_sdv.md)
  :

  SportsDataverse theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_sdv_team()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_sdv_team.md)
  :

  Team-colored SportsDataverse theme for `gt` tables

## gt Table Themes

Editorial and broadcast-style themes for gt tables, ported from gtUtils.
`theme_bg` holds each theme’s background color for matching a saved
image’s canvas.

- [`gt_theme_almanac()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_almanac.md)
  :

  Record-book theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_athletic()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_athletic.md)
  :

  The Athletic theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_booktabs()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_booktabs.md)
  :

  Academic booktabs theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_broadsheet()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_broadsheet.md)
  :

  Editorial serif theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_brutalist()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_brutalist.md)
  :

  Heavy-rule display theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_drench()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_drench.md)
  :

  Saturated single-color theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_gtutils()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_gtutils.md)
  :

  gtUtils theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_kenpom()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_kenpom.md)
  :

  KenPom theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_midnight()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_midnight.md)
  :

  Dark theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_ncaa()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_ncaa.md)
  :

  NCAA theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_pl()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_pl.md)
  :

  Premier League theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_savant()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_savant.md)
  :

  Baseball Savant theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_scoreboard()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_scoreboard.md)
  :

  Broadcast-graphics theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_sofa()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_sofa.md)
  :

  SofaScore theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_swiss()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_swiss.md)
  :

  International Typographic Style theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_terminal()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_terminal.md)
  :

  Data-terminal theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_tier()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_tier.md)
  :

  Tier list theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_tufte()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_tufte.md)
  :

  Minimal-ink theme for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_preview()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_preview.md)
  : Preview data in every theme

- [`pal_midnight`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/pal_midnight.md)
  : A rank palette for dark backgrounds

- [`theme_bg`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/theme_bg.md)
  :

  Background colors used by the `gt_theme_*()` table themes

## Table themes by source

122 surveyed table styles, by the name of the source they follow
(`datagolf`, `wikipedia`, `nejm`, …), shared with the Python and
JavaScript packages.
[`gt_theme_source()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_source.md)
and
[`reactable_sdv_theme()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/reactable_sdv_theme.md)
apply any of them; the shortcuts name the most useful 20.

- [`sdv_table_themes()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_table_themes.md)
  : List the surveyed table themes

- [`table_theme_spec()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/table_theme_spec.md)
  : Resolve a surveyed table theme

- [`gt_theme_source()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_source.md)
  :

  A surveyed table style as a `gt` theme

- [`reactable_sdv_theme()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/reactable_sdv_theme.md)
  : A surveyed table style as a 'reactable' theme

- [`gt_theme_basketball_reference()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_basketball_reference.md)
  :

  Basketball-Reference table style for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_datagolf()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_datagolf.md)
  :

  DataGolf table style for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_fivethirtyeight_site()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_fivethirtyeight_site.md)
  :

  FiveThirtyEight (forecast tables) table style for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_wikipedia()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_wikipedia.md)
  :

  Wikipedia wikitable table style for `gt` tables

- [`gt_theme_cleaning_the_glass()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/gt_theme_cleaning_the_glass.md)

  Cleaning the Glass table style for `gt` tables

  Opta Analyst table style for `gt` tables

  Our World in Data table style for `gt` tables

  Bloomberg.com Markets table style for `gt` tables

cache.

  : Leagues sdvplotR knows

  : Teams in the sdvplotR index
- [`sdv_resolve()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_resolve.md)
  : Resolve team identifiers to canonical team ids
- [`sdv_suggest()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_suggest.md)
  : Suggest teams for a value that did not resolve
- [`sdv_team_colors()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_team_colors.md)
  : Team colours
- [`sdv_color_palette()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_color_palette.md)
  : Team colour palette
- [`sdv_team_factor()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_team_factor.md)
  : Order Team Names as a Factor
- [`sdv_logo_url()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_logo_url.md)
  : Team logo and wordmark URLs
- [`sdv_marks()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_marks.md)
  : Every archived mark for a team
- [`sdv_headshot_url()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_headshot_url.md)
  : Player headshot URLs
- [`sdv_versions()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_versions.md)
  : Versions of the data sdvplotR is using
- [`sdv_clear_cache()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_clear_cache.md)
  : Clear the sdvplotR caches

## Court and Pitch Coordinates

Convert stats.nba.com shot locations and any soccer provider’s event

  : Convert Shot Locations to a sportyR Court Frame
- [`sdv_pitch_coords()`](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/reference/sdv_pitch_coords.md)
  : Convert Soccer Event Coordinates to the sdvplotR Pitch Frame

# Articles

### Gallery

- [Gallery](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/gallery.md):

  Every article by its picture: a figure the article draws, or a preview
  of a table theme for the articles built on tables.

### Getting Started

- [Getting Started with
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/getting-started.md):

  Install sdvplotR and draw your first team logos, colors and headshots
  in ggplot2, gt and reactable across the 28 leagues of the
  SportsDataverse team index.

### Per-Sport Articles

Data ingest with the companion SportsDataverse package, then sdvplotR
visualization, for each sport.

- [NFL Visualizations with nflverse and
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/nfl-viz.md):

  Ten charts and tables from the 2025 NFL season with nflreadr and
  sdvplotR: offense against defense with logos, standings, quarterback
  headshots, relocated franchises and a team-colored field.

- [College Football Visualizations with cfbfastR and
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/cfb-viz.md):

  Ten charts and tables from the 2025 college football season with
  cfbfastR and sdvplotR: every FBS team on one scatter, conference
  standings, the Playoff bracket, quarterback headshots and tiers.

- [NBA Visualizations with hoopR and
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/nba-viz.md):

  Ten charts and tables from the 2025-26 NBA season with hoopR and
  sdvplotR: a ratings quadrant, net-rating bars, a bump chart,
  headshots, a team-colored shot chart and an interactive version.

- [WNBA Visualizations with wehoop and
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/wnba-viz.md):

  Ten charts and tables from the 2026 WNBA season, the first with 15
  teams, with wehoop and sdvplotR: a ratings quadrant, expansion win
  races, headshots, a binned shot chart and an interactive chart.

- [MLB Visualizations with baseballr and
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/mlb-viz.md):

  Ten worked examples on the 2026 MLB regular season: standings, run
  differential, Statcast, home run leaders, a spray chart, the division
  races, franchise moves and a tier list.

- [NHL Visualizations with fastRhockey and
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/nhl-viz.md):

  Ten worked examples on the 2025-26 NHL season: standings, goal
  differential, expected goals, a shot map on the rink, scoring and
  goaltending leaders, the Coyotes-to-Utah lineage, the points race and
  the playoff tiers.

- [Men's College Basketball Visualizations with hoopR and
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/mbb-viz.md):

  Division I men’s basketball has more than 360 teams in 31 conferences,
  and the conferences change from one season to the next.

- [Women's College Basketball Visualizations with wehoop and
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/wbb-viz.md):

  Division I women’s basketball has more than 360 teams, and each shares
  its ESPN id with the school’s men’s team.

- [Soccer: any provider's shots on one
  pitch](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/soccer-viz.md):

  Convert soccer event coordinates from any major provider to one 105 x
  68 m pitch frame with sdv_pitch_coords(), then draw them with
  sdvplotR.

### Cookbooks

Task-oriented, cross-league recipes: logos and headshots in ggplot2,
team colors and themes, interactive charts, playing surfaces and shot
charts, and reactable tables (with reactablefmtr).

- [Logos, wordmarks and headshots in
  ggplot2](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/cookbook-ggplot-logos.md):

  Twelve ggplot2 recipes: logos as points, at bar and line ends, on axes
  and beside titles, in tier lists, plus sizing, overlap, past seasons’
  marks, any image, headshots and social-size exports.

- [Team colors and
  themes](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/cookbook-colors-themes.md):

  Ten recipes for team colors: a league’s palette, colors per row, team
  fill and outline scales, clashing colors, readable text on team fills,
  named palettes, conference colors, dark backgrounds, and choosing a gt
  theme.

- [Interactive
  charts](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/cookbook-interactive.md):

  Twelve recipes for team logos on web charts: ggiraph tooltips, hover
  highlights and logo axes, plotly logos as layout images, leaflet logo
  markers, a reactable table, self-contained HTML and static PNG exports
  for social posts.

- [Surfaces and shot
  charts](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/cookbook-surfaces-shot-charts.md):

  Eleven recipes for playing surfaces: every sport’s surface, team
  colors and a center logo, NBA and WNBA shot charts with
  sdv_court_coords(), a rotated half court, a college shot chart, a
  hockey goal map, a baseball field and a football drive chart and
  Euroleague shots on the FIBA court.

- [reactable
  Integration](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/reactable-integration.md):

  sdvplotR provides a family of helpers for embedding team logos,
  wordmarks, player headshots, and team-colored bars in reactable
  tables.

- [reactable and reactablefmtr
  cookbook](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/cookbook-reactable.md):

  Ten recipes for team tables on the web: reactablefmtr data bars,
  heatmap tiles, icon sets, pill buttons, merged columns, image
  comparisons and themes, plus wordmarks, grouped rows, conference logos
  and expandable rows in reactable, across six leagues.

### Tables cookbook

gt tables on SportsDataverse data: the house themes, standings with cut
lines, percentile bars, rank changes, schedule matrices, tier lists,
faceted and snaked layouts, and saving for social. The gt\_\* toolkit
comes from Andrew Weatherman’s gtUtils.

- [SportsDataverse Table
  Themes](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/sdv-table-themes.md):

  The SportsDataverse table themes for gt: gt_theme_sdv() in light or
  dark, and gt_theme_sdv_team() dressed in one team’s colors.

- [Table theme
  registry](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/table-themes.md):

  Every surveyed table theme: the source it copies, its dark policy, a
  preview, and the call for gt and reactable.

- [Team Tables with the gt
  Toolkit](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/gt-toolkit.md):

  The two kinds of gt helpers on one table: the team layer of logos,
  headshots and colors, and the table toolkit of themes, legends and cut
  lines.

- [Styling Headers, Legends, and
  Captions](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/styling.md):

  Style headers, legends and captions in gt tables through the
  named-list arguments of gt_title_header() and the other helpers that
  take them.

- [Saving and Posting
  Tables](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/saving_tables.md):

  Save gt tables as images sized for each platform, crop the whitespace,
  and post the same table to the web and to social feeds.

- [Border
  Bars](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/border_bars.md):

  Colored bars above or below a gt table with gt_border_bars_top() and
  gt_border_bars_bottom(), stacked or as a single accent.

- [Percentile Bars and Cut
  Lines](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/delay_tables.md):

  Percentile bars, cut lines and significance marks that show which
  values in a gt table stand out and where one group ends and the next
  begins.

- [Creating Faceted
  Tables](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/grid_tables.md):

  Split a long gt table into side-by-side panels with gt_grid(), so 25
  rows fit an image shaped for posting.

- [Building a Schedule
  Matrix](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/schedule_matrix.md):

  A schedule matrix puts one team per row and one week per column, and
  draws each opponent’s logo in the cell where they met.

- [Creating Tier
  Lists](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/tier_list.md):

  A tier list ranks teams into colored bands, best band on top, each
  band a row of logos.

- [Winningest Franchises in Rolling
  Windows](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/window_wins.md):

  The NFL’s five winningest franchises in every ten-year window from
  1999-2008 to 2016-2025, each drawn as its logo and shaded by its Super
  Bowl wins.

### Recipes

Real-world tasks worked end to end: the brief, the data, a first draft,
the fixes that make it publishable, and the export at the size it will
be posted. Then static versions of SportsDataverse web visuals, and
end-to-end workflows.

- [NFL EPA
  Scatter](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-nfl-epa-scatter.md):

  Make the offense-vs-defense EPA chart for social after the Super Bowl,
  from a first draft to 1200 x 675 and 1080 x 1080 exports.

- [CFB Conference
  Table](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-cfb-conference-table.md):

  Build the final Big Ten standings table for a newsletter, with logos,
  records and game-by-game margin bars, exported 1600 px wide and as a
  square for social.

- [NBA Net Rating
  Quadrant](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-nba-net-rating-quadrant.md):

  Chart every NBA team’s offensive and defensive rating by conference,
  with logos, average lines and net-rating guides, for a blog post and a
  square social post.

- [WNBA Scoring Leaders
  Card](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-wnba-scoring-leaders-card.md):

  Make a WNBA scoring-leaders card with headshots, team logos and
  team-color bars, exported at 1080 x 1080 for Instagram and as a
  top-five 1200 x 675 cut for X.

- [MLB Run
  Differential](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-mlb-run-differential.md):

  Build a 1600 px blog graphic of MLB run differential: ranked bars in
  team colors with logos at the bar ends, beside the season’s running
  totals for the best and worst teams.

- [NHL Shot
  Map](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-nhl-shot-map.md):

  Map every unblocked shot of the Stanley Cup clincher on a rink in team
  colors, sized by expected goals, with the goals, a scoreboard and
  exports at 1200 x 675 and 1600 x 900.

- [College Hoops
  Tiers](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-college-hoops-tiers.md):

  Turn a power rating into a Big Ten men’s basketball tier list with
  sdv_team_tiers(), the tiers cut at the rating gaps, exported for
  social at 1200 x 675 and 1080 x 1080.

- [Rank Bump
  Chart](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-rank-bump-chart.md):

  Draw the college football season’s AP Top 25 as a bump chart, with
  logos at the line ends and the biggest climbers called out, exported
  for a blog and for X.

- [Head-to-Head
  Card](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-head-to-head-card.md):

  Make a Super Bowl tale-of-the-tape card: two teams’ seasons as
  mirrored league-rank bars in team colors with dark-background logos,
  exported at 1200 x 675 and 1080 x 1080.

- [WBB Conference
  Standings](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-wbb-conference-standings.md):

  Build the final SEC women’s basketball standings table, with logos,
  every conference result as a win-loss strip and how each season ended,
  dressed in the champion’s colors and exported for a newsletter and a
  4:5 Instagram post.

- [Neighbour
  Ranks](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/neighbour-ranks.md):

  One team in the middle of an 11-row table, with the five teams ranked
  just above and below it, so the gaps to its neighbours show next to
  the rank.

- [Shot
  Grid](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/shot-grid.md):

  A shot chart cut into a grid of zones, each colored by a shooter’s
  percentage against the league from that spot, rather than one dot per
  attempt.

- [Rolling
  Form](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/rolling-form.md):

  Each team’s last 150 offensive plays against the 150 before them,
  drawn so a change in form shows before the season average catches up.

- [Signature
  Ribbon](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/signature-ribbon.md):

  A shooter’s profile as a ribbon: how often each distance is attempted
  and how well it is made, drawn along the shot distance.

- [End-to-End Workflows with sdvplotR and the SportsDataverse
  Ecosystem](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/workflows.md):

  End-to-end workflows: load data from SportsDataverse packages, draw it
  with sdvplotR, and export the charts and tables.

### Interactive

The recipes as charts and maps a reader can hover, filter and zoom, with
ggiraph, plotly and leaflet. Start with the Interactive Charts cookbook;
every leaderboard and per-sport article also ends with an interactive
version.

- [Interactive NFL EPA
  Scatter](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-nfl-epa-interactive.md):

  Turn the offense-vs-defense EPA chart into a web chart: hover a logo
  for the team’s numbers and ranks, fade the other 31, and share it as
  one HTML file.

- [Interactive NBA Net
  Rating](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-nba-net-rating-interactive.md):

  Build the NBA offense-vs-defense quadrant in plotly with team logos
  and hover details, then a net-rating bar chart with logos on the axis,
  and share both as web pages.

- [Interactive NHL Shot
  Map](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-nhl-shot-map-interactive.md):

  Turn the Stanley Cup clincher’s shot map into a web chart: hover a
  shot for the shooter, period, time, shot type and result, hover a
  shooter to light up all of his shots, and keep each team’s logo and
  score beside its end.

- [Interactive MLB Run
  Differential](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-mlb-run-differential-interactive.md):

  Make the season’s run differential ranking a web chart: team-color
  bars with logos on the axis, a hover card with each team’s record and
  runs, and a linked view of run differential against winning percentage
  with the Pythagorean expectation.

- [CFB Stadium
  Map](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/recipe-cfb-stadium-map.md):

  Put every FBS program on a map as its logo at its home stadium: hover
  for the school, click for the stadium, switch conferences on and off,
  and share it as one HTML file.

- [Team maps with
  leaflet](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/cookbook-leaflet-maps.md):

  Five leaflet maps with team logos as markers: every MLB ballpark with
  its dimensions, the parks by division, team-colored circles sized by
  wins, spring training with clustered markers, and the coast-to-coast
  Big Ten.

### Leaderboards

Each league’s current season, rebuilt every week with this site: the
season to date while games are played, the last full season in the
offseason.

- [NFL Weekly
  Leaderboard](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/leaderboard-nfl-weekly.md):

  The NFL season to date, rebuilt every week: a power table by EPA per
  play, offense against defense, and a quarterback leaderboard with
  headshots.

- [College Football Weekly
  Leaderboard](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/leaderboard-cfb-weekly.md):

  The college football season to date, rebuilt every week: a top 25 by
  opponent-adjusted EPA per play, every FBS team by conference, and the
  top 25’s offense against its defense.

- [NBA
  Leaderboard](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/leaderboard-nba.md):

  The latest NBA season, rebuilt every week: standings with net rating,
  a net rating chart with logos on the axis, and the scoring leaders
  with headshots.

- [WNBA
  Leaderboard](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/leaderboard-wnba.md):

  The latest WNBA season, rebuilt every week: standings with net rating,
  offense against defense with logos, and the scoring leaders with
  headshots.

- [MLB
  Leaderboard](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/leaderboard-mlb.md):

  The latest MLB season, rebuilt every week: division standings, run
  differential with logos, and the league leaders with headshots.

- [NHL
  Leaderboard](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/leaderboard-nhl.md):

  The latest NHL season, rebuilt every week: standings, goal
  differential with logos on the axis, and the points leaders with
  headshots.

- [Leaderboard Dashboards with sdvplotR, gt, and
  Quarto](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/leaderboard-dashboards.md):

  Leaderboard dashboards with sdvplotR, gt tables and Quarto: team
  logos, colors and rankings laid out for a page that updates.

### Automation

Make and post social graphics on a schedule.

- [Social Graphics,
  Automated](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/automation-social.md):

  One Rscript makes season leaderboards, final-score cards and a
  player-of-the-game card from SportsDataverse data, writes their alt
  text and captions, and posts them to Bluesky on a GitHub Actions
  schedule.

- [Social Posting Patterns with
  sdvplotR](https://sdvplotR.sportsdataverse.org/articles/social-posting.md):

  Shareable sports graphics with sdvplotR: team logos, colors and titles
  sized and exported for X, Bluesky and Instagram.
